RDp'd into ZT610, flushed media queue, cleared error flag. Printer shows Ribbon out. Re‑loaded SPF-PRN-LBL08 media type, label ok. User test pending.

Hello Deanna, your incident has been resolved: Updated the label template file on SPF-PRN-LBL08 from the MES. tickets.summary: No connectivity on office desktop
tickets.details: User reports no network on desktop SPF-PSW-C1-15. Cable plugged in, but status shows 'unidentified'.
tickets.resolution: A misconfigured BPDU guard caused the port to block traffic. After disabling BPDU guard and clearing the error, the port is active and SPF-PSW-C1-15 reconnects to the network.

worklog.text: Confirmed that SPF-PSW-C1-15 is on the correct VLAN but the port is still down. Fixing requires a network team action. Transferring to Desktop Support - SPF.
Desktop Support - SPF to Network Operations: ticket not relevant to us. Handed over.
SPF-PSW-C1-15 offline after desk shift. Checked port on N3248TE-ON, BPDU guard tripped. Undisabled, set VLAN 102, power cycle laptop. User reports connectivity restored.

Hello Nicole, your incident has been resolved: A misconfigured BPDU guard caused the port to block traffic. After disabling BPDU guard and clearing the error, the port is active and SPF-PSW-C1-15 reconnects to the network. If the issue returns, reply to this email within 5 days to reopen.
